THROB.gloss: pulsate or pound with abnormal force
THROB.definition: Pulsate or pound with abnormal force.

BROTH.gloss: liquid in which meat and vegetables are simmered
BROTH.definition: Liquid in which meat and vegetables are simmered; used as a basis for e.g. soups or sauces.
BROTH.example: She made gravy with a base of beef stock.

BOTH.definition: (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two.

HOT.definition: Used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning.

ROB.gloss: take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
ROB.definition: Take something away by force or without the consent of the owner.
ROB.example: The burglars robbed him of all his money.

BOT.definition: Botfly larva; typically develops inside the body of a horse or sheep or human.

ROT.gloss: a state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor
ROT.definition: A state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor.
